, when evaluating a graph generative model using MMD, one needs to carefully consider and control the perturbations of the graphs, and to be mindful of the potential pitfalls that can be caused by MMD.

, when comparing graph generative models via MMD, it is important to use a large number of samples, to use a suitable distance function, to use a proper baseline, to account for the effect of graph sampling, and to account for the size of the graphs.
